column1: # Third-party skill repositories installed per device.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# These skills live in their own git repos, so they are .gitignore'd from
# claude-config (tracking them would either bloat this repo or create broken
# gitlinks). Without this manifest a fresh clone silently lacks them and there
# is no record of what was supposed to be there -- exactly how skills/gstack
# and skills/humanizer became empty, unrecoverable directories (removed
# 2026-07-27; gstack was github.com/garrytan/gstack, humanizer's origin was
# already unrecoverable by then).
# FORMAT: <dest-path-relative-to-~/.claude><TAB><git-clone-url>
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Consumed by scripts/install-third-party-skills.sh (called from bootstrap.sh).
# TO ADD a third-party skill: add its line here AND a matching entry in
# .gitignore, then commit both. Never let one exist without the other.
# NOT EVERY THIRD-PARTY SKILL BELONGS HERE. This mechanism clones a whole repo
# to skills/<dest>/, so it only works when that repo has SKILL.md at its ROOT.
# A repo that nests skills one level down (skills/<name>/SKILL.md) would land
# the file too deep to be discovered. Those are vendored as tracked files
# instead -- copied in, committed, with origin + pinned commit recorded in a
# PROVENANCE.md beside them. Vendored skills are NOT listed below and are NOT
# .gitignore'd; they are tracked, so the silent-disappearance failure this
# manifest guards against does not apply to them.
# Vendored (tracked, not cloned):
#   skills/ponytail  <- github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail (skills/ponytail/SKILL.md)
#                       see skills/ponytail/PROVENANCE.md for pin + update steps
